paite: TOUPA'N, "Ta helhatte atung uh agik hi! Huaite'n mi adong ua, kei lah hon dong kei uh, akhelhna tung ua khelhna abehlapna ding un, khuhna in akhuh ua, ka kha thu in lah akhuh tuan kei uh.
heading: Aiguptate Toh Kilemna Phatuam Lou
english: “Woe to the rebellious children,” says Yahweh, “who take counsel, but not from me; and who make an alliance, but not with my Spirit, that they may add sin to sin,

paite: Pharaoh hatna a kihatsak ding in leh Aigupta lim bel ding a ka kam dong tuan lou in Aigupta gam a paisuk tum in akuan uhi.
english: who set out to go down into Egypt, and have not asked my advice; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to take refuge in the shadow of Egypt!

paite: Huaiziak in Pharaoh hatna noute zahlakna ahita ding a, Aigupta lim na belh uh lah na maizumna uh ahita ding.
english: Therefore the strength of Pharaoh will be your shame, and the refuge in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.

paite: Amiliante lah Zoan ah a-om ua, apalaite Hanes khua atungta ngal uhi.
english: For their princes are at Zoan, and their ambassadors have come to Hanes.

paite: Amau a dia phattuamna himhim nei lou mi, huhna hilou, phattuamna neimi leng hilou, maizumna leh minsiatna hi zawte, avek un azumpih ding uh," achi hi.
english: They shall all be ashamed because of a people that can’t profit them, that are not a help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.”

paite: Sim gam a sate puakgik, buaina leh lunglauna gam, humpinelkainu leh humpinelkaipa, guldekpak leh gul kuang lengthei pawtna, asum uh sabiltungnou tungte ah, agou uh sangawngsau nungvumte ah posak in, amau a dia phattuamna nei lou mite kiang a piak ding in, apaiton dapdap uhi.
english: The burden of the animals of the South. Through the land of trouble and anguish, of the lioness and the lion, the viper and fiery flying serpent, they carry their riches on the shoulders of young donkeys, and their treasures on the humps of camels, to an unprofitable people.

paite: Aigupta in lah phatuam loutak leh panna nei loutak in apanpih zel ngal a; huaiziak in ahi, amah, Rahab tu kinkennu, ka chih.
english: For Egypt helps in vain, and to no purpose; therefore have I called her Rahab who sits still.

paite: Tu in pai inla, huaite ama ua laigelhna pek ah gelh inla, laibu ah leng gelh in, tunung a tangtawn dong a ding ahihtheihna ding in.
heading: Thumang Lou Mipite
english: Now go, write it before them on a tablet, and inscribe it in a book, that it may be for the time to come forever and ever.

paite: Huaite lah mihelhatte, ta zuautheite, ta TOUPA dan ngaikhe nuamloute ahi ngal ua.
english: For it is a rebellious people, lying children, children who will not hear the law of Yahweh;

paite: Mutheite kiang a, “Mu kei un," zawlneite kiang a, "Thil dikte hon hilhkhol kei un, thil nuam lam ka kiang uah gen un, khemna thu gen un, khemna thu genkhol un.
english: who tell the seers, “Don’t see!” and to the prophets, “Don’t prophesy to us right things. Tell us pleasant things. Prophesy deceits.

paite: Lampi lou ah pai un, lamsik ah pial un, Israelte Mi Siangthou ka ma ua kipan hihmang un," chi ngitngette.
english: Get out of the way. Turn aside from the path. Cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us.”

paite: "Huaiziak in Israelte Mi Siangthou in hichi in achi, hiai thu na muhsit ziak un leh nuaisiahna leh phengphitna na muan ua, atung ua na kingak ziak un.
english: Therefore thus says the Holy One of Israel, “Because you despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and rely on it;

paite: Hiai thulimlouhna noute a ding in suangbaang sangpi se lai, chim dekdek, puak eng ong, thakhat a mitphialkal lou a segawp ding bang ahi ding hi.
english: therefore this iniquity shall be to you like a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking comes suddenly in an instant.

paite: Huchi in belvelmi bel akitap gawpsak bang un, hawi om het lou a keknen in, athemnen lak ah belpei thuk a mei lakna ding hiam tuikhuk a tui dipna ding om lou khop in, akitam nensak ding," chi in.
english: He will break it as a potter’s vessel is broken, breaking it in pieces without sparing, so that there won’t be found among the broken piece a piece good enough to take fire from the hearth, or to dip up water out of the cistern.”

paite: Toupa PATHIAN, Israelte Mi Siangthou in hichi in achi, "Kik nawn a khawl in hotdam in na om ding ua; muangtak a omna ah leh ginna omna ah na hatna uh a-om ding, chi in; himahleh nou na ut kei uhi.
english: For thus said the Lord Yahweh, the Holy One of Israel, “You will be saved in returning and rest. Your strength will be in quietness and in confidence.” You refused,

paite: Hilou e, sakol tung a tuang in i tai zozot ding uh," na chi zosop ua, huaiziak in na tai zozot ngei ding uh. "Thil hattak tung ah i tuang ding, na chi ua; huaiziak in nou hon delh ding lah hattak ahi ding uh."
english: but you said, “No, for we will flee on horses”; therefore you will flee; and, “We will ride on the swift”; therefore those who pursue you will be swift.

paite: Mi khat phawn in sangkhat ataikek ding ua; mi nga phawn in na taikek ding uh; atawp in mualvum a puankhai khai bang leh tang tung a chiamtehna om bang a nutsiat in na om ding uhi.
english: One thousand will flee at the threat of one. At the threat of five, you will flee until you are left like a beacon on the top of a mountain, and like a banner on a hill.

paite: Huaiziak in noute TOUPA'N ahon hehpih theihna ding in ahon ngak ding a, huaiziak in noute tung a zahngaihna asuahtheihna ding in pahtawi in a-om ding hi; TOUPA lah vaihawm diktatna Pathian ahi ngal a; amah ngakte tengteng in nuam asa uhi.
english: Therefore Yahweh will wait, that he may be gracious to you; and therefore he will be exalted, that he may have mercy on you, for Yahweh is a God of justice. Blessed are all those who wait for him.

paite: Mite Jerusalem a Zion ah om ding ahi ngal ua; na kap nawn kei ding uh; na kahna husa uah ama'n ahon hehpih mahmah ding a; azaktak in ahon dawng ding hi.
heading: Pathian In Amite Avualzawl Ding
english: For the people will dwell in Zion at Jerusalem. You will weep no more. He will surely be gracious to you at the voice of your cry. When he hears you, he will answer you.

paite: TOUPA lungkhamna tanghou leh haksatna tui hon pe mahleh, nou hon sinsak mite akibu nawn kei ding ua, na mit un nou hon sinsak mite amu zawta ding hi.
english: Though the Lord may give you the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, yet your teachers won’t be hidden anymore, but your eyes will see your teachers;

paite: Huan taklam a na pial un hiam, veilam a na pial un hiam, na bil un na nunglam uah, "Hiai alampi ahi, hiai ah pai un," chi in thu azata ding hi.
english: and when you turn to the right hand, and when you turn to the left, your ears will hear a voice behind you, saying, “This is the way. Walk in it.”

paite: Na dangka uh milim bawl dangka chi a zepna leh na dangka-eng uh, milim sun dangka-eng tui a luanna na buahsak ding ua; thilnin bang in na paita ding ua, akiang ah, "Paimang in!" na chi ding uh.
english: You shall defile the overlaying of your engraved images of silver, and the plating of your molten images of gold. You shall cast them away as an unclean thing. You shall tell it, “Go away!”

paite: Huchi in ama'n na buhchi uh lei a na tuh ding uh a ding in vuahtui ape ding a; lei a thilpoute leng an ding in ape ding, huai lah hoihtak pungtak ahi ding; huai ni chiang in gantatna mun zapi ah na gantate uh ata ding ua,
english: He will give the rain for your seed, with which you will sow the ground; and bread of the increase of the ground will be rich and plentiful. In that day, your livestock will feed in large pastures.

paite: bawngtal leh sabengtungnou lei lette'n an chisoh, ninluahna leh phazah a hihsiangsa ane ding uh.
english: The oxen likewise and the young donkeys that till the ground will eat savory provender, which has been winnowed with the shovel and with the fork.

paite: Kithahna thupitak ni a galvenna singte achip ni in, tang sang teng ah leh mualvum sang teng ah luipite leh luite tui luang ahong om ding.
english: There shall be brooks and streams of water on every lofty mountain and on every high hill in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.

paite: Huai lou leng TOUPA'N amite kihehna atuam a, aliamna ma uh adamsak ni chiang in, khavak nivak pha in a-omta ding a, nisa vak amun sagih in, ni sagih vakpha in a-omta ding hi.
english: Moreover the light of the moon will be like the light of the sun, and the light of the sun will be seven times brighter, like the light of seven days, in the day that Yahweh binds up the fracture of his people, and heals the wound they were struck with.

paite: Ngai in, TOUPA min, ahehna kuang zuazua in, meikhu sahtak a zamtou lak ah, gamlapi a kipan in ahong pai hi; amukte lung hihlouhna in adim a, alei thil katmang hat mei bang ahi.
heading: Pathian In Assuria Asawi Ding
english: Behold, the name of Yahweh comes from far away, burning with his anger, and in thick rising smoke. His lips are full of indignation, and his tongue is as a devouring fire.

paite: Ahu lah, manna lohpi a namte sep ding in, lui ngawng chiang pha hial a akuang a let bang ahi; michih kam ah pikhelhsakna kaihgingna khau a-om ding.
english: His breath is as an overflowing stream that reaches even to the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of destruction; and a bridle that leads to ruin will be in the jaws of the peoples.

paite: Zan a zehtan siangthou a zeh atan lai ua la asak bang un, la asa ding ua; TOUPA tang a Israelte' Suangpi kiang tung ding a tamngai toh apai lai ua lungtang nopsakna anei bang un lungtang nopsakna leng anei ding uhi.
english: You will have a song, as in the night when a holy feast is kept; and gladness of heart, as when one goes with a flute to come to Yahweh’s mountain, to Israel’s Rock.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N a-aw thupitak akizasakta ding a, ahehna thupitak leh thil katmang ching meikuang in, ahuihpi leh vuahpi leh gial in, akhut khakdan a-ensakta ding.
english: Yahweh will cause his glorious voice to be heard, and will show the descent of his arm, with the indignation of his anger, and the flame of a devouring fire, with a blast, storm, and hailstones.

paite: TOUPA aw ziak in Assuria mi, khetbuk a mi khen nakpa, kitapzansak a om ding ahi ngal a.
english: For through the voice of Yahweh the Assyrian will be dismayed. He will strike him with his rod.

paite: Amah lah chiangkhun sehsa a TOUPA'N azep peuhmah chiang in khuangtate leh kaihgingte toh azep ding a; achiang lik a kisualnate ah amau asual ding.
english: Every stroke of the rod of punishment, which Yahweh will lay on him, will be with the sound of tambourines and harps. He will fight with them in battles, brandishing weapons.

paite: Tophet khat lah tuma a na bawlkholhsa ahi ngal a; ahi, kumpipa a ding in bawlzoh siang ahi a; thutak zatak in abawl a; athil sekkhawm mei leh sing tamtak ahi a; TOUPA hu, kat luiluang bang in, akangsak zuazua hi.
english: For his burning place has long been ready. Yes, for the king it is prepared. He has made its pyre deep and large with fire and much wood. Yahweh’s breath, like a stream of sulfur, kindles it.
